name: bld3_pell_five_neg_one_solutions
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_fib_odd_index_iff_five_sq_sub_four and Mathlib2.bld2_lucas_sq_sub_five_fib_sq: (2x)^2 + 4 = 5 (2y)^2, so 2y = fib (2m+1) and 2x = L_(2m+1) by the odd-index description and the Lucas–Fibonacci identity; fib (2m+1) even forces 3 ∣ 2m+1, i.e. 2m+1 = 6n+3.
type: ∀ (x y : ℕ), x ^ 2 + 1 = 5 * y ^ 2 → ∃ n, 2 * y = Nat.fib (6 * n + 3) ∧ 2 * x = Mathlib2.p3_lucas (6 * n + 3)
